title: 参照画像の一人のちび天使の女の子をそのまま使用する。
content:
参照画像の一人のちび天使の女の子をそのまま使用する。
顔、髪型、羽、服装、体型、色、比率を参照画像から一切変えない。
Unityでレンダリングしたような高品質なゲームを彷彿とさせるカートゥーンアニメーション。
セルルック寄り、柔らかいスタジオライティング、白い背景だけの完全な空間。
床は白く、うっすら反射と柔らかい影がある。
オレンジ色のバスケットボールを1個持っている。
対戦相手は黒いシルエットだけで表現されたディフェンダー1人。
ディフェンダーはキャラクター性を持たず、主役は常にちび天使。
女の子の全身が常に見えるワイドショット。
カメラは基本固定。
要所のみ軽いズームイン、軽いドリーイン、わずかな手持ち感を使用してスピード感を強調する。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
アニメーションは超高速なスナップアニメーションを最優先。
モーションキャプチャ風ではなく、
熟練アニメーターによるゲームの必殺技モーションのような手付けアニメーション。
Pose to Pose Animation。
キーフレーム主体。
中割りは最小限。
ゲームのダッシュキャンセルや格闘ゲームのステップのような、
視認できないほど鋭いスナップ移動を多用する。
通常の走りは極力使用しない。
移動は

↓

次の位置へ現れる。

切り返し前には必ず逆方向への小さな予備動作を入れる。
オーバーシュートを大きく使う。

en.content:
---
Use the little angel girl from the reference image as is. Do not change the face, hairstyle, wings, clothing, body shape, color, or proportions from the reference image. Cartoon animation reminiscent of high-quality games rendered in Unity. More cel-look, soft studio lighting, a completely white background space. The floor is white with a slight reflection and soft shadows. She holds one orange basketball. The opponent is a defender represented only by a black silhouette. The defender has no character traits, and the main focus is always on the little angel. A wide shot where the girl's entire body is always visible. The camera is mostly fixed. Use light zoom-ins, light dolly-ins, and slight handheld feel only at key moments to emphasize speed. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ The animation prioritizes ultra-fast snap animation. Not motion capture style, but hand-drawn animation like a skilled animator's special move in a game. Pose to Pose Animation. Keyframe-based. Minimal in-betweens. Frequent use of sharp snap movements that are almost imperceptible, like dash cancels in games or steps in fighting games. Avoid regular running as much as possible. Movement is a cycle of: Complete stop ↓ Preparatory action ↓ Instant acceleration ↓ Appearing in another place ↓ Complete stop. Prioritize the impression of "disappearing and reappearing" rather than "running." In high-speed movement, the character momentarily disappears, leaving only 2-4 short afterimages before appearing at the next position. The movement itself is almost invisible. Direction changes are instant at 90°, 180°, 270°. Always include a small preparatory action in the opposite direction before a turnaround. Use large overshoots. After stopping, only the hair, wings, and clothes sway with inertia. Each pose holds completely still for 0.1-0.2 seconds. Showcase the silhouette most beautifully. Hair, wings, sleeves, clothes, and shoelaces always have natural Follow Through. Squash & Stretch. Anticipation. Overshoot. Follow Through. Smear Frame. Stretch Frame. Appeal. Short afterimages. Thin speed lines. Subtle motion blur. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Dribbling is ultra-low dribble like an NBA top guard. The ball doesn't rise above the knees. High-speed dribbling of 4-6 times per second or more. Crossovers are instantaneous. Through-the-legs is sharp. Behind-the-back is fast. Always continue dribbling without holding the ball. The center of gravity is very low. The soles of the feet firmly grip the floor. Ball physics are natural. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 15-second short animation ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【0.0-1.5 seconds】 The little angel walks in while slowly dribbling with one hand. Her steps are small. Her wings and hair sway softly. Finally, she looks forward. Holds still for 0.1 seconds. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【1.5-2.5 seconds】 Spots the defender in front. Her feet stop abruptly while continuing to dribble. Narrows her eyes. In the next moment, her eyes open wide. Her eyebrows jump up. Her wings lift slightly. Surprise pose. Holds still for 0.15 seconds. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【2.5-4.5 seconds】 Begins ultra-low dribble. Right. Left. Right. Left. Hesitation. Stop. Instant move to the right. Stop. Instant move to the left. Stop. Instant move forward. Stop. Instant move back to the original position. The defender reacts in the opposite direction each time. The girl has a confident smile. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【4.5-7.5 seconds】 High-speed crossover. Stop. Instant move to the right. Stop. Through-the-legs. Stop. Instant move to the left. Stop. Behind-the-back. Stop. Instant move forward. Stop. Crossover. Stop. Instant move backward. Stop. Crossover. Stop. All movements are portrayed as disappearing ↓ reappearing. Short afterimages of 2-4 frames. The defender is completely outmaneuvered. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【7.5-10.5 seconds】 Spin move. Stop. Instant move to the right. Stop. Hesitation. Stop. Instant move to the left. Stop. Double crossover. Stop. Instant move forward. Stop. Behind. Stop. Right edge of the screen. Stop. Left edge of the screen. Stop. Directly behind the defender. Stop. Back to the front. Stop. Speed as if she has multiplied. The defender is completely confused. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【10.5-12.5 seconds】 Complete stop. Silence. In the next moment, explosive dash. Passes the defender in an instant. Wings flow backward. Hair sways greatly. Short afterimages. Thin speed lines. Footwork is ultra-light. Acceleration like a special move in a game. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【12.5-14.0 seconds】 In front of the goal. One dribble. Stop. Crouch. Explosive jump. Slightly twists her body in the air. Wings spread wide. Smile. One-handed dunk. The ring bends slightly. The net shakes vigorously. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【14.0-15.0 seconds】 Landing. Light squash. Wings. Hair. Sleeves. Clothes. All sway with a slight delay. Catches the ball with one hand. The little angel winks at the camera. Finally, a smile. Holds still for 0.5 seconds. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【Quality Specification】 Smooth game animation. Unity quality. Cel-look. High-quality character animation. Game special move motion. Ultra-fast snap animation. Hand-drawn animation by skilled animators, not motion capture. Pose to Pose Animation. Keyframe-based. Strong silhouette. Clear stop poses. Game dodge motion. Fighting game steps. Dash cancel. High-speed movement like teleportation. Movement that feels like "disappearing and reappearing" rather than "running." Realistic ball handling like an NBA top guard. Ultra-low center of gravity. High-speed crossover. Through-the-legs. Behind-the-back. Spin move. Hesitation. Natural ball physics. Exaggerated cartoon physics. Smear Frame. Stretch Frame. Squash & Stretch. Anticipation. Overshoot. Follow Through. Appeal. Complete stop when stopping. Instant maximum speed when moving. Refreshing tempo like a game victory performance. Cute and comical acting. Full body display. White background. Studio quality. Throughout the entire video, prioritize expressing overwhelming speed, sharp snaps like game animation, turnarounds like teleportation, and a pleasing rhythm of speed changes.

---
Utilizar tal cual la imagen de referencia de una pequeña niña ángel.
No cambiar en absoluto la cara, peinado, alas, vestimenta, complexión, color y proporciones de la imagen de referencia.
Animación de dibujos animados que recuerda a un juego de alta calidad renderizado en Unity.
Con un estilo cel-shading, iluminación suave de estudio, un espacio completamente blanco de fondo.
El suelo es blanco, con un leve reflejo y sombras suaves.
Sostiene una pelota de baloncesto naranja.
El oponente es un defensor representado solo por una silueta negra.
El defensor no tiene carácter, la protagonista es siempre la pequeña ángel.
Toma amplia donde siempre se ve el cuerpo completo de la niña.
La cámara está básicamente fija.
Solo se utiliza un ligero zoom in, un ligero dolly in y una leve sensación de cámara en mano para enfatizar la sensación de velocidad.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
La animación prioriza una animación de snap ultra rápida.
No es estilo captura de movimiento,
sino una animación manual como los movimientos especiales de un juego realizada por un animador experto.
Pose to Pose Animation.
Principalmente keyframes.
Se minimizan los intercalados.
Se utilizan muchos movimientos de snap tan rápidos que son casi invisibles, como los dash cancels de un juego o los pasos de un juego de lucha.
Se evita al máximo el correr normal.
El movimiento es
Parada completa
↓
Acción preparatoria
↓
Aceleración instantánea
↓
Aparecer en otro lugar
↓
Parada completa
repetidamente.

Se prioriza la impresión de
"desaparecer y aparecer"
en lugar de "correr".
En el movimiento rápido,
el personaje desaparece por un instante,
dejando solo un rastro corto de 2 a 4 imágenes
y aparece en la siguiente posición.
El movimiento en sí es casi invisible.
Los giros se cambian instantáneamente a 90°, 180°, 270°.
Antes de cambiar de dirección, siempre se incluye una pequeña acción preparatoria en la dirección opuesta.
Se utiliza un gran overshoot.
Después de detenerse, solo el cabello, las alas y la ropa se mueven con inercia.
Cada pose se detiene completamente durante 0.1 a 0.2 segundos.
La silueta se muestra de la manera más hermosa.

El cabello, las alas, las mangas, la ropa y los cordones de los zapatos siempre tienen un Follow Through natural.
Squash & Stretch.
Anticipation.
Overshoot.
Follow Through.
Smear Frame.
Stretch Frame.
Appeal.

Rastro corto.
Líneas de velocidad delgadas.
Motion blur moderado.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
El dribbling es un dribbling ultra bajo como el de un guardia top de la NBA.
La pelota no sube más alto que las rodillas.
Dribbling rápido de más de 4 a 6 veces por segundo.
El crossover es instantáneo.
El leg-through es agudo.
El behind-the-back es rápido.
No se sostiene la pelota, siempre se continúa driblando.
El centro de gravedad es muy bajo.
Las plantas de los pies agarran firmemente el suelo.
La física de la pelota es natural.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Animación corta de 15 segundos
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
